about.title:
Real people.

about.subtitle: We're not a marketplace. We're a love brand.
about.meaningBody: ‘Inkko’ is a small parakeet — the one that, in the wild, chooses a single mate and stays with them for life. We took that name because it captures exactly what we are about: lifelong partnership, loyalty, and quiet devotion. inko nikah isn't an app. It's a brand built around the kind of love that lasts.
about.meaningNote: We don't measure success in matches. We measure it in the relationships that are still standing five, ten, twenty years later.
about.visionBody: To become the most trusted name in serious, global matchmaking — the brand people choose when they're done playing.
about.missionBody: We exist to introduce sincere, verified people to one partner worth keeping — and to walk with them as that relationship grows.
values: Verification is the foundation of trust.
We are accountable beyond the introduction.

process.title: How we introduce.
process.subtitle: From the first profile to arriving in Korea — six steps, six to eight months on average.
process.notice: Getting to know each other takes up to three months — it can go faster, and the pace is yours to set. After her parents' blessing, the wedding date is fixed within an agreement period of up to three months.

steps.title: Profile exchange
steps.body: Only verified members' profiles are shared. Your matchmaker matches values and circumstances on both sides.

steps.title: First meeting
steps.body: The first face-to-face, by video or in person. We are there to interpret — there is nothing to worry about.

steps.title: Ten days of talking
steps.body: If it feels right on both sides, you talk every day for ten days and confirm it.

steps.title: Visiting Indonesia · meeting the family
steps.body: The male member spends three days in Indonesia and meets her parents to receive their blessing. Once given, an agreement period of up to three months begins.

steps.title: The wedding
steps.body: The ceremony takes place on the date the two of you set within the agreement period. He flies home to Korea and returns for the ceremony; registration, paperwork, interpretation, and scheduling are on us.

steps.title: Korean exam · F-6 visa
steps.body: Preparing the spouse visa (F-6). We prepare the Korean language exam and paperwork with you, through arrival in Korea.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.subtitle: If you don't find your answer here, we'd rather you just write to us.

items.a: inko nikah is for people who are serious. Members tend to be in their late 20s through their 40s, established in their lives, and ready for one real relationship — not another casual try.

items.q: How is this different from a dating app?
items.a: We don't run a feed and we don't run an algorithm. A real human matchmaker reads your profile and personally chooses each introduction. There is no swipe culture.
Globally — Korea, Japan, the U.S., Canada, Australia, and beyond. Membership is curated, not geographic.

items.q: How long does the process usually take?
items.a: On average six to eight months, from the first profile exchange to arriving in Korea. Everyone moves at their own pace, and we never force the schedule.

items.q: What's the difference between the tiers?
items.a: Standard, Standard Plus, and Premium differ in introduction depth, meeting coordination, and aftercare. Most members choose Standard Plus.
Yes, with stage-based rules. We walk through them in writing before any contract is signed.

items.q: Is the relationship supported after we commit?
items.a: Yes. Aftercare is part of every tier — three months in Standard Plus, a full year in Premium, plus quarterly check-ins for as long as you'd like.
Family meetings, translation, and milestone coordination are part of the Premium tier and available as add-ons in others.
